additional_info.body:
Hello Chlöe, good morning. Hope you are doing well.
The error is:
It seems that the Modbus connection to the IMD is missing.
Please check the following cables:
I would as first try to swap BC1 with BC2 , change the Modbus address:
If the error persists in the BC2, then please try replacing it.
If the error is now in BC1, then it must be related to the cables:
Check this connector, take them apart from each other (B and A) and reconnect them:
If the error still persists, then we might need to go to last resort which is to replace the KF11.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
